instruction.name: vftintrzh.l.s
instruction.description: Convert single-precision floating point elements in higher part of every 128-bit vector of `a` to signed 64-bit integer, rounding towards zero.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Register-to-register dependency chain. Source values are normal floats or small integers as appropriate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vftintrzh.l.s $vr0, $vr8; vftintrzh.l.s $vr1, $vr9; vftintrzh.l.s $vr2, $vr10; vftintrzh.l.s $vr3, $vr11; vftintrzh.l.s $vr4, $vr12; vftintrzh.l.s $vr5, $vr13; vftintrzh.l.s $vr6, $vr14; vftintrzh.l.s $vr7, $vr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vftintrzh.l.s $vr0, $vr8; vftintrzh.l.s $vr1, $vr9; vftintrzh.l.s $vr2, $vr10; vftintrzh.l.s $vr3, $vr11; vftintrzh.l.s $vr4, $vr12; vftintrzh.l.s $vr5, $vr13; vftintrzh.l.s $vr6, $vr14; vftintrzh.l.s $vr7, $vr15'

notes: LSX vector conversion. Measured on LA664 with normal float or small integer source values; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
